create_runner_subclass: create a subclass of Runner that implements description, add_args, create_from_args, display_output_location, and run
implement_add_args: implement the add_args method to register command line flags for a custom Runner subclass
implement_create_from_args: implement create_from_args to instantiate a Runner subclass from argparse.Namespace arguments
implement_run: implement the run method in a Runner subclass to execute a training job
implement_display_output_location: implement display_output_location in a Runner subclass to print the job output path
